items.text:
Currently unplayable to me.   
I had high but modest hopes for this game having loved Neo scavenger and accepting it's significant quirks.  

The game relies on a very unfun mechanic to me, top-down and fps 2D Vacuum space driving, requiring you to deal with acceleration and deceleration on two axis. This can be ok on some games like top down simple shooters. But this is a rougelike and one accidental collisions can end your game. Then also you have to deal with small batteries that have a range of about 1 destination, you cannot buy them at the start and only have two, any makes driving and you'll run out of power.   

It's also extremely buggy right now, I died twice just leaving the start point on boarding my ship, unclear why. Installing my second battery also failed twice somehow installation got stalled at 35% and I could not restart it or find out how to finish it.

Maybe i didn't give this gave enough time to master the flight control, but honestly after almost 2 hours i didn't want to, i hate this flying method. 

I hope the game will change significantly, and if so I will change my review, but I doubt they'll dump the flying and it wouldn't make sense to dump the rougelike aspect..
items.text_zh:
目前对我来说没法玩。
因为很喜欢《新拾荒者》并且接受它那些明显的怪癖，我对这款游戏抱有很高但不算过分的期望。

这游戏依赖一个在我看来非常不好玩的机制：俯视视角和第一人称视角的2D真空太空驾驶，要求你在两个轴上处理加速和减速。这在某些游戏里还行，比如俯视视角的简单射击游戏。但这是个roguelike，一次意外碰撞就能终结你的游戏。然后你还得应付小电池，其续航大约只够跑一个目的地，开局你买不到它们，而且只有两块，随便开一开就会没电。

现在它还有极其多的bug，我在登船离开起点时就死了两次，原因不明。安装第二块电池也失败了两次，不知怎么安装卡在35%，我既没法重新开始，也不知道怎么完成它。

也许我没给这游戏足够的时间来掌握飞行控制，但老实说，快两个小时之后我也不想掌握了，我讨厌这种飞行方式。

我希望游戏会有重大改变，如果真是这样我会改我的评测，但我怀疑他们会砍掉飞行，而且砍掉roguelike元素也说不通。
